ety.text: Originally from -ка (-ka) added to adjectives ending in -яный (-janyj) or -яно́й (-janój); later extracted out as its own suffix.

s.g: ah, aah, oh (expressing understanding or realisation)
aah (a cry of horror, the sound of screaming)

ety.text: Inherited from Proto-Slavic *tesla / *teslo (“adze”), from Proto-Indo-European *tetḱ-dʰlo-, from *tetḱ-. Cognate with Serbo-Croatian те̏сла, Polish ciosła, Old Norse þexla (“axe”), Old High German dehsala (“axe, adze”).
